puppeteer_mcp.note: Puppeteer documents chrome-devtools-mcp as a Puppeteer-based MCP server.

selenium.note: SeleniumHQ issue #15969 remains an open request for an official Selenium MCP server.

tools.name: chrome_devtools_tools_list
tools.description_it: Restituisce nomi e JSON Schema correnti direttamente dal server ufficiale Chrome DevTools MCP.
tools.description_en: Returns the current tool names and JSON Schemas directly from the official Chrome DevTools MCP server.

tools.name: chrome_devtools_call
tools.description_it: Invoca un tool ufficiale Chrome DevTools MCP usando esattamente il nome e gli argomenti dello schema upstream.
tools.description_en: Calls an official Chrome DevTools MCP tool using the exact upstream tool name and arguments.

tool.description: Nome esatto tool upstream / Exact upstream tool name.

arguments.description: Argomenti conformi allo schema upstream / Arguments matching the upstream schema.

tools.name: chrome_webmcp_tools_list
tools.description_it: Espone gli strumenti WebMCP ufficialmente integrati in Chrome DevTools MCP.
tools.description_en: Lists the WebMCP tools officially integrated into Chrome DevTools MCP.

tools.name: chrome_webmcp_call
tools.description_it: Invoca list_webmcp_tools o execute_webmcp_tool tramite Chrome DevTools MCP.
tools.description_en: Calls list_webmcp_tools or execute_webmcp_tool through Chrome DevTools MCP.

tool.description: Tool WebMCP ufficiale da invocare / Official WebMCP tool to invoke.

tools.name: puppeteer_mcp_tools_list
tools.description_it: Restituisce gli strumenti del server MCP Puppeteer-based raccomandato dal progetto Puppeteer: chrome-devtools-mcp.
tools.description_en: Lists tools from the Puppeteer-based MCP server recommended by the Puppeteer project: chrome-devtools-mcp.

tools.name: puppeteer_mcp_call
tools.description_it: Invoca chrome-devtools-mcp con semantica Puppeteer; non usa il vecchio server-puppeteer archiviato.
tools.description_en: Calls chrome-devtools-mcp as the Puppeteer MCP path; it does not use the archived server-puppeteer package.

tool.description: Nome esatto tool upstream / Exact upstream tool name.

arguments.description: Argomenti conformi allo schema upstream / Arguments matching the upstream schema.

tools.name: selenium_tools_list
tools.description_it: Restituisce gli strumenti dell'adapter minimale basato su selenium-webdriver ufficiale. SeleniumHQ non pubblica un server MCP ufficiale al 21/08/2026.
tools.description_en: Lists the minimal adapter tools backed by official selenium-webdriver. SeleniumHQ does not publish an official MCP server as of 2026-08-21.

tools.name: selenium_call
tools.description_it: Invoca un'operazione dell'adapter basato sulla libreria ufficiale selenium-webdriver 4.47.0.
tools.description_en: Calls an operation in the adapter backed by the official selenium-webdriver 4.47.0 library.
